title: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sents.t: Ashley Rayne and her fiancé are away from home when their security camera inside their apartment captures something disturbing.
sents.zh: Ashley Rayne 和未婚夫不在家时，公寓里的监控摄像头拍到了让人不安的东西。

sents.t: Ashley writes, "We were moving out of our apartment and caught this on our camera.
sents.zh: Ashley 写道：“我们正在搬出公寓，结果摄像头拍到了这个。

sents.t: My cat won't take its eyes off of it."
sents.zh: 我的猫一直盯着它看，眼睛都不眨。”

sents.t: There appears to be someone or something peeking at the cat from behind the doorway.
sents.zh: 好像有人——或者某种东西——躲在门框后面偷看那只猫。

sents.t: But it does so in a very strange manner.
sents.zh: 但它偷看的方式非常奇怪。

sents.t: It seems to be peeking sideways, with its hands gripping the doorway's frame on one side.
sents.zh: 它好像是侧着身子偷看，双手抓着门框的一边。

sents.t: But as if that wasn't creepy enough, it seems to ascend and then disappear.
sents.zh: 好像这还不够吓人，它似乎还往上升，然后消失了。

sents.t: Both Ashley and her fiancé have no clue as to what this could have been.
sents.zh: Ashley 和未婚夫都完全不知道那会是什么。

sents.t: Now, this could be someone who had broken into their apartment, but there's something odd about this person, and what they do seems physically impossible for anyone to do.
sents.zh: 这可能是闯进他们公寓的人，但这个“人”有点怪，它的动作似乎是任何人都不可能做到的。

sents.t: It's a good thing Ashley is moving out, as I doubt she'd want to stay there after seeing this.
sents.zh: 还好 Ashley 要搬走了，我想看到这个之后，她也不会想再住下去了。
